rankings.summaryHtml: If Kevin Durant wrests the MVP trophy away from LeBron James, it won't be because of LeBron fatigue. It's because Durant's on course to become just the seventh player ever to average 31-plus points, 7-plus rebounds, and 5-plus assists for an entire season. This tweet here lists KD's six predecessors.

rankings.summaryHtml: A little history lesson to perhaps lift some of the gloom in the wake of the sad Danilo Gallinari news: Denver was a combined 25-107 during the previous two seasons the Broncos went to the Super Bowl. So 22-21, despite all of this season's ups and downs in the Mile High, doesn't sound so bad.
